name: Teardrop trailer
definition: small towed living trailer with a teardrop profile, a sleeping cabin and a rear-hatch galley, without standing room inside.
notes: Fretz RV page sells a used nuCamp TAG XL teardrop, 14 ft, sleeps 2, outdoor kitchen

name: Stroller wagon
definition: wheeled box-bodied carrier with harnessed seats for two or more children, pushed like a stroller or pulled by a handle.
notes: Listed under Strollers > Stroller Wagons: WonderFold two-seat wagon, 5-point harness, push or pull strap

name: Flats and bay boat
definition: shallow-draft open saltwater fishing boat with a poling or casting platform, made for bays and tidal flats.
notes: Flats Boats is a type page: shallow draft, poling platform; bay boats not a separate type on this page

name: River raft
definition: inflatable open boat of large tubes, paddled or rowed by a group, made for whitewater rivers.
notes: Rafts category: self-bailing whitewater and fishing rafts from NRS, AIRE, Hyside, Badfish; packrafts listed separately

name: Paramotor (powered paraglider)
definition: backpack engine and propeller worn by a foot-launched pilot under a paraglider wing.
notes: Parajet paramotor packages: engine, harness with reserve pocket and propeller; foot-launched under wing

name: parking space
definition: a bay or space for parking a vehicle held as land (freehold or long lease); a rented bay or permit is OUT.
notes: Rightmove type list includes Parking as its own property type; no description given

name: campsite
definition: land laid out and held for camping, touring pitches or glamping units, with or without amenity buildings.
notes: Campsites for sale category: pitch-based and glamping sites; tenure and prices not shown

name: solar farm
definition: land whose principal use is a ground-mounted photovoltaic array, sold with or as a site for it.
notes: Cocampo browse category 'Land for solar panels' under Land and plots; no listings shown

name: golf course
definition: land laid out as a golf course, with or without a clubhouse (`improvements`).
notes: UK golf courses sold freehold, most with clubhouses, as whole or in lots

name: airstrip
definition: land laid out as a runway or landing strip for light aircraft, with or without hangars (`improvements`).
notes: 102.5-acre tract with airpark runway, fuelling, offices and hangars listed for sale

name: manual blood-pressure kit
definition: gauge with arm cuff and hand bulb, read by listening with a stethoscope (aneroid sphygmomanometer, with or without stethoscope).
notes: Aneroid sphygmomanometer with cuff, inflation bulb and stethoscope sold as a set

name: peak flow meter
definition: handheld tube with a scale that measures how fast a person can breathe out, used to monitor asthma.
notes: Peak Flow Meter category defined as handheld device measuring how well air leaves lungs; only nasal unit listed

name: HbA1c home test kit
definition: one-use kit that measures average blood glucose (HbA1c) from a fingerstick blood sample.
notes: ADA guide lists A1CNow Self Check as A1C home kit: fingerstick sample, result in five minutes

name: steam inhaler
definition: device that makes warm steam to be breathed in for cold, cough or sinus relief, without liquid medicine.
notes: Beurer SI30 steam inhaler: warm steam from tap water for cold, cough, sinus; no medicine

name: electronic magnifier
definition: camera-and-screen device, handheld or desktop, that enlarges print and images for a low-vision user (video magnifier, CCTV).
notes: Electronic Video Magnifiers category with Desktop and Portable types; HD camera and display models

name: fat burner
definition: thermogenic supplement sold to support fat loss alongside training.
notes: Fat Burners & Thermogenics category, 29 products from many brands

name: protein snack
definition: snack other than a bar (chips, crisps, cookies) sold for its protein.
notes: Quest Nutrition Protein Chips listed under snacks; bar comparison not visible in fetched text

name: contact-lens rewetting drops
definition: drops put in the eye with lenses in place to rewet and soothe them.
notes: Bausch + Lomb contact lens drops lubricate and rewet lenses during wear; separate from cleaning solutions
